You can send in almost any type of message for entry in OUTBOARD in any format: a DATA statement, Tasword file, handwritten letter etc. "Ideally", it should not be larger than 10 screen lines. We consider it to have fulfilled its purpose (e.g. "Club meeting on the 6th").
